name: Mykonos Riviera Hotel & Spa
positioning: Five-star hotel built amphitheatrically across Tourlos Marina, 1.9 km from Mykonos Town, with beach access across the road, a thalassotherapy spa and multi-bedroom maisonettes and villas
best_for: Families or groups wanting multi-bedroom maisonettes or villas with Aegean views
Spa-focused travelers wanting a thalassotherapy pool and a traditional hammam
Travelers who want to be close to Mykonos Town without staying in it

facts.text: The hotel is in Tourlos Marina, next to Mykonos Town.
The hotel is 1.9 km from Mykonos Town, with an included transfer service.
The hotel is amphitheatrically built directly across the marina, a few minutes from Agios Stefanos beach.
There is direct beach access just across from the hotel, with views of the marina and Mykonos Town.
The architecture combines white-washed curves, handcrafted stone elements and timber pergolas.
The Oqua Spa has an indoor heated thalassotherapy pool, a traditional hammam and a fully equipped gym.
The Oqua Spa massage menu includes an authentic olive oil massage.
The Oqua Spa is open to day visitors as well as hotel guests.
The main infinity pool is heated and has fiber optic lighting.
Maisonettes and villas come with two, three, four or eight bedrooms and Aegean views.
The suites can host families of up to five.
LAFS Restaurant is led by Executive Chef Stergios Bitsis, who reinvents traditional Greek recipes with a contemporary approach.

highlights.text: The hotel offers a fleet of yachts, sailing boats and rib boats for transfers and half-day or full-day cruises to the south coast of Mykonos or the island of Delos.
The 8-Bedroom Villa sits at the highest point of Mykonos Riviera, with Aegean, sunset and Mykonos Town views.
The Signature Spa Pool Suites include a private sauna and steam room.
Some rooms have sea views with private outdoor hot tubs or heated pools.
Many pool suites and maisonettes include complimentary daybeds at nearby St Stefanos beach.

considerations.text: The beach is just across from the hotel rather than on the property itself.
Airport and port transfers are available on request.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury Mykonos properties.
